scope: Decrypted business carrier only. This contract does not establish device enrollment, Noise interoperability, a connected Host, native UI or store readiness.
envelope: Every business frame has v=1, a bounded opaque id, positive safe-integer timestamp, type and payload. Contextual integer fields require ASCII digit tokens without sign, decimal or exponent; opaque unknown numeric values retain their original spelling. Event payload wraps {event,data,seq?,sessionId?}. Preserve complete original bounded UTF-8 JSON alongside typed routing fields; do not flatten structured history or round-trip unknown numeric values through a lossy representation. rpc.response payload.result is opaque at the outer layer: describe returns a raw capability object and stream open/close return raw acknowledgements. Only harness.remote.call wraps the Typert {ok,value?}/{ok:false,error} result; optional success value must remain optional.
requests: Call params are {endpoint,payload:{args:A}}; stream open adds streamId, close uses {streamId}. Register a stream before dispatching its open RPC because its first value may precede acknowledgement. A harness.remote.frame has streamId, hasValue:true and optional value; preserve omitted value distinctly from explicit JSON null. The transport port supplies an authenticated connection generation and Host/workspace/session binding, which every response/event must match before mutation.
recovery: RPC ids correlate exactly once, not deduplicate Host side effects. Persist each logical mutation identity before send. Disconnect or deadline after sending leaves mutation outcome unknown; never replay it. New connection/stream/$events client identities require fresh authoritative snapshots. History snapshot cursor and durable sequence are distinct from transient assistant attempt/revision/index and unsequenced carrier events.
stop: session/cancel accepted=true means receipt only. Do not mark a run stopped until authoritative Host state confirms it. session/prompt success result is unspecified by upstream; do not invent a receipt schema.
approval: Existing $events/result clientId/eventId/outcome lacks the complete workspace/run/action/expiry binding required by Quenderin. Decode and preserve approval requests; fail closed on decision dispatch until a reviewed negotiated Host extension supplies and enforces that binding. Encoding an upstream packet is not authorization to send it.
retryHazards: Do not inherit RESPONSE_TOO_LARGE call-to-transfer fallback: the Host checks response size after invoking the mutation. Device refresh must be single-flight; retrying a consumed refresh token revokes device credentials. No automatic mutation or refresh replay.
